tile_bonus_audit.hypothesis: Tile bonuses determine route optimality around Step 301
tile_bonus_audit.findings: The Kaggriculture environment rules (kg_env_dump.py) contain ZERO tile bonuses or location-based multipliers. All 5x5 farm tiles possess identical physical dynamics. The only bonuses in the engine are Animal Care yield bonuses (+1 product per care before harvest) and Town Shop consumption demand.
tile_bonus_audit.verdict: REJECTED — Tile bonuses do not exist in the Kaggriculture environment.

shop_availability_audit.step72_analysis: YARN_STORE at Step 72 prompts both agents to enter the Yarn route. When YARN_STORE does not unlock at Step 72, both agents default to Backbone.
shop_availability_audit.step144_analysis: YARN_STORE at Step 144 triggers Yarn or Bakery-Yarn route in V54++. V54++ already exploits this causal shop gating.
shop_availability_audit.step216_analysis: Step 216 shop switching was proven NO-GO in the previous forensic audit because switching at Day 9 destroys macro synchronization on the majority of seeds.

v66_source_forensics.inputs: _public_signature(obs): reads opponent money, opponent hand count, and opponent asset counts (cows, sheep, wheat, melon)
v66_source_forensics.output_action: Overrides route to specific historical replay action tapes (e.g. _V58_RECOVERY_ROUTE, _V58_ICE_MINIMAX_ROUTE, _V58_KNOWN_YARN_ROUTE)
v66_source_forensics.flaw: Against an unseen opponent like V54++, opponent assets do not match these hardcoded historical tuples. V66's signature checks fail, causing it to fall back to _v59_route and _V58_RECOVERY_ROUTE on Bakery seeds. V66's occasional high performance on those seeds is an accident of hardcoded route fallback, not generalizable intelligence.
